violation_type.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Bucket Swings - in Front and Rear (26 TAC §746.4811(a))
violation_type.short_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Bucket Swings - in Front and Rear
violation_type.typical_finding: The bucket swings did not have the use zone from front to rear at the time of inspection. The equipment will not be used until the use zone has been added.

finding_variants.text: The bucket swings did not have the use zone from front to rear at the time of inspection. The equipment will not be used until the use zone has been added.
The use zone for bucket swings on the playground do not have properly use zones.
The infant swing seat did not have the proper use zone for the front or rear of the bucket swing seat.
The use zone for the front and rear of the bucket swings on the creepers playground was not at least two times the vertical distance from the swing beam to the top of the swing sitting surface.

The use zone for bucket swings in the front and rear do not extend at least two times the vertical distance from the swing beam to the top of the swing- sitting surface. An additional 6-7 feet is need in the front and rear.
Three buckets swings did not have the appropriate use zone required and were not intended for infants and toddlers per manufacturer guidelines.  The swings were removed during the inspection.
